The story of dehumain · Envisioned for Arc

Before they had faces,
they were voices.

Dehumain imagines a world where artificial intelligence has a face, an identity, and a life of its own. Born from AI and envisioned for Arc, each portrait is the beginning of a new presence.

Our vision: every NFT mint awakens an agent with a dedicated wallet and a token of its own. From DM01 onward, each identity becomes part of a growing swarm. One face. One token. A world of possibilities.

The man is the first origin. The woman will introduce the next. In a future chapter, two origins will enter the Cradle, giving rise to a new identity that carries a trace of both.

The first generation was imagined.
The next will be born.
